reviewType: development editorial inspection, not independent expert review
reason: Passing schema checks did not ensure fidelity to primitive constraints.

findings.responsive-turn: Introduced feeding and dressing as contexts without an applicability review.
findings.shared-attention: Directed adult positioning and attention rather than consistently following the child's existing attention.
findings.shared-book: Invented book content and a prior family memory; reported hypothetical observations as facts.
findings.routine-language: Introduced objects and a task command; overstated learning interpretation.
findings.responsive-imitation: Interpreted breath and eyes as evidence of connection.
findings.shared-story: Invented personal memories and recorded hypothetical events as observations.

correctiveAction: Compiler v2 requires optional observable noticing, generic adult phrasing, explicit opt-out, no invented memory and no added care tasks. These filters are guardrails, not proof of safety.
